mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be fresh kiwi fruit, which is a whole fruit with moderate carbohydrate content and fiber that may lead to a gentler effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes than refined carbohydrate foods. It is generally a lower glycemic choice; if additional carbohydrate control is needed, pairing fruit with a high-fiber or protein-containing food can further moderate glycemic impact.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Two kiwi fruit halves, representing approximately one whole fresh kiwi, served plain.
